description: This file is a client-side API utility module for a React-based web application. It provides functions to build URLs, summarize text (locally or via backend), save notes, and retrieve notes, with fallback mechanisms to localStorage if backend is unavailable.
external_files: process.env (environment variables in Node.js or bundler environment)

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for backend endpoints based on environment variable REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

methods.name: localSummarize
methods.description: Provides a simple fallback summary by extracting the first two sentences or first 160 characters of the text.

methods.name: isBackendReachable
methods.description: Checks if the backend server is reachable by sending a GET request to the base URL.

methods.name: summarizeText
methods.description: Attempts to get a summary of the content from the backend; falls back to local summarization if backend is unavailable or fails.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves a note object to the backend if reachable; otherwise stores it in localStorage, returning the saved note with an ID.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes from the backend if available; otherwise from localStorage.
